### Travere Therapeutics to Participate at Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 3, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/270034868/files/doc_news/Travere-Therapeutics-to-Participate-at-Upcoming-Investor-Conferences-797399285-2026.pdf)


SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Travere Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: TVTX) today announced that company management will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:


**Guggenheim Global Healthcare Conference**
Presenting on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET


**Stifel 2026 Healthcare Conference**
Presenting on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 3:20 p.m. ET


**UBS Global Biopharma Conference**
Presenting on Monday, November 16, 2026, at 11:20 a.m. GMT


**Jefferies London Healthcare Conference**
Presenting on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. GMT


Live webcasts of the presentations will be accessible on the Investor page of Travere’s website at[ir.travere.com/events-and-presentations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.travere.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54634665&newsitemid=20261103317035&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.travere.com%2Fevents-and-presentations&index=1&md5=d6342cb1c8c9eacfbd62d02eeeb411b6) . Replays will be available for up to 30 days following each event.


**About Travere Therapeutics**


At Travere Therapeutics, we are in rare for life. We are a biopharmaceutical company that comes together every day to help patients, families, and caregivers of all backgrounds as they navigate life with a rare disease. On this path, we know the need for treatment options is urgent – that is why our global team works with the rare disease community to identify, develop, and deliver life-changing therapies. In pursuit of this mission, we continuously seek to understand the diverse perspectives of rare patients and to courageously forge new paths to make a difference in their lives and provide hope – today and tomorrow. For more information, visit[travere.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.travere.com&esheet=54634665&newsitemid=20261103317035&lan=en-US&anchor=travere.com&index=2&md5=d59f5c54592016bc1c65c9e8b11dc5c6) .
